title: Translating addresses
hints: The last byte of an access is at `address + size - 1`; the pages touched run from `pageOf(address)` to `pageOf(that last byte)`.

The table is a `std::map` from page number to `Entry`. `table.find(page)` returns `table.end()` when the page is not mapped; otherwise `it->second` is its `Entry`. For the `std::optional` result, `return physical;` gives a value and `return std::nullopt;` gives none.
In `check`, go through every page touched. Return `NotMapped` the moment a page is missing; only remember a read-only page, because a missing page later on should still win.
